# Shop requirements

1. Cart management
   The shopping cart holds the customer's chosen items.

1.1 Adding items
   An item added to the cart appears in its contents.

1.1.1 Duplicate items increase the quantity rather than adding a second line.

1.1.2 Adding an item with a non-positive quantity is rejected.

1.2 Totals
   The cart reports the total price of its contents.

2. Invoicing

2.1 An invoice is produced for a cart at checkout.
